title: Props, Equipment, Effects & Foreground Composition
objective: Compose ARI/PAPT props, equipment, items, effects, overlays and foreground elements as presentation-only SAA references, including attachment hints that never mutate canonical equipment ownership, actor state, Scene state, source resources or owner-domain truth.
acceptance: Foreground composition consumes governed ARI/PAPT resource references for props, equipment, items, effects, overlays and other foreground elements rather than copying canonical owner truth or source bytes.
Each composed foreground element preserves stable resource identity plus provenance, rights/use-capability and applicable production-primitive references.
Attachment hints are explicitly presentation-only and cannot create or mutate Character/NPC/Creature equipment ownership, inventory, anatomy, mechanics, live state or Scene placement.
Unsupported, unavailable, stale, rights-blocked or incompatible resources and attachment hints fail closed with explicit state rather than fabricating coverage.
Foreground elements bind into SAA-03 composition using stable layer identity, z-order and panel bounds without rewriting sealed SAA-01..07 identities or geometry.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can inspect, select, attach and compose every blocking foreground operation without requiring drag gestures.
Provider-off local operation is supported for locally available governed resources; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-09 and later lettering/export/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: ARI retains resource identity/provenance/rights authority; PAPT/PCA retain production-primitive authority; Character/NPC/Creature/Inventory/Equipment owner domains retain canonical ownership/mechanics/live-state authority; Scene retains canonical placement truth.
SAA-08 composes presentation-only foreground references and attachment hints; it may not create canonical equipment ownership, inventory state, actor mutation or Scene mutation.
No source bytes copied into a parallel SAA foreground library by default and no silent fallback for unsupported resources.
No export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-08.
